 Medium
 Large
 Print Just three days before its release in theaters, the upcoming movie of Dhanush , 'O.M,' has undergone a very important pre-release activity. The movie has been certified by the censor board, providing satisfaction to the audience members who were eagerly waiting for news about it. This movie, directed by Rajkumar Periasamy , has created much curiosity from the time of its announcement. The makers are now gearing up for its release, with the censor clearance adding to the excitement. 'OM' gets U/A certificate with nearly three-hour runtime
 As per the official announcement, the Dhanush-starrer has been awarded a U/A certificate by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC). The certified length of the film is around 179 minutes, equivalent to 2 hours 59 minutes. Due to its long duration, one can expect a detailed cinematic viewing experience from it. The audience will now be curious to see how Rajkumar Periasamy has shaped the story and maintained the pace throughout the nearly three-hour drama. The censor clearance also puts an end to the uncertainty surrounding the film's certification. Join conversation

 Dhanush's 'O.M' faces title buzz before censor clearance
 The film had also grabbed attention over its title. There was discussion around the use of 'OM' as the film's title, following which the makers reportedly made a change in its presentation to 'O.M'. The issue also reminded fans of the controversy surrounding the use of the term 'O.M' in Vijay 's 'Jana Nayagan', where the reference to an operation named O.M was reportedly changed to MM. With Dhanush's film now receiving its U/A certificate, the title-related discussions appear to have settled. 'O.M' advance bookings expected to begin soon
 'O.M' features a strong ensemble cast, including Mammootty , Sai Pallavi and Sreeleela in important roles. The film marks Rajkumar Periasamy's next directorial venture after the success of 'Amaran'. With the censor formalities completed, advance ticket bookings are expected to open soon. Special early morning shows are also likely to add to the opening-day excitement, although the makers are yet to confirm the schedule. All eyes are now on whether the Dhanush-starrer can make a strong impact at the box office.
